thread:
Priya Sharma: quick follow-up from today's all-hands. leadership wants a short, concrete set of target windows for API, Console, and Optimize so we don't leave customers guessing. can owners + blockers be listed here?

Ben Ortiz: good call. we should give targets but flag them as "dependent on infra/SLOs". i can draft comms once owners and dates are confirmed. :+1:

Marco Valdez: proposed targets (rough): API runtime canary 2024-05-18, GA end of May; Console UX beta 2024-06-12, GA late June; Optimize suggestions alpha 2024-07-03 (internal) -> small pilot 2024-07-10. assumes quant infra + canary profiles are ready.

Alice Chen: Console note: beta needs per-org feature flags and rollouts. aiming to have flags + admin UI by 2024-06-05 to enable a week of pilot flips before beta.

Dana Liu: SRE ask: we need SLO pass/fail criteria and canary traffic profiles by 2024-05-02. if those aren't locked, canary should be pushed. also need staging capacity numbers from eng-platform.

Sofia Rivas: Optimize scope for alpha = batching + recommendation hints + dashboard; no billing integration or autoscale yet. we want 3 pilot customers to validate suggestions.

Marco Valdez: owners (tentative): Marco -> API runtime & compatibility; Alice -> Console rollout & flags; Sofia -> Optimize suggestion models; Dana + Evan -> infra & SLO gating; Ben -> external comms.

Priya Sharma: can each owner confirm by EOD? i'll hold webinar notes until confirmed.

Alice Chen: confirmed for Console. will post a short checklist for flagging + admin flows by tomorrow.

Marco Valdez: confirmed for API. action: post compatibility test plan in #eng-runtime by 2024-04-28.

Ben Ortiz: confirmed for comms. i'll prepare a slide with qualifiers and keep it labeled "targets".

deploy-bot: task queued: provision canary staging GPUs for API runtime on 2024-05-01 03:00 UTC :robot_face:

Priya Sharma: schedule snippet (pinning here):
```
API runtime: canary 2024-05-18 -> GA late May (target)
Console UX: flags ready 2024-06-05 -> beta 2024-06-12 -> GA ~2024-06-26
Optimize suggestions: internal alpha 2024-07-03 -> limited pilot 2024-07-10
```

Priya Sharma: thanks all. please drop any blockers or deviations in this thread by EOD so i can finalize comms.
